latest_release.name: YesPlayMusic 3.0.0
latest_release.body:
老朋友们，YesPlayMusic 终于更新了！（对，没跑路）

这次带来的是船新版本：用 Flutter 从头重写，界面全部重新设计，原生运行，不再是套壳网页，安装包也小了不少，来看看都有什么新东西 👇

### ✨ 新特性

- **唱片架音乐库**：专辑像实体唱片一样排列在架子上，配合底部时间轴快速定位
- **Coverflow**：复刻 iPod 和 iTunes 上的经典 Coverflow，翻阅专辑、歌手和歌曲
- **本地音乐**：添加音乐文件夹即可播放，自动读取封面和歌词
- **插件**：在线音乐由插件提供，可接入 Jellyfin、Emby、Plex 等媒体服务器，也可以参考 [插件开发指南](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/blob/main/docs/plugins.md) 自己开发
- **AI 助手**：通过 MCP 让 AI Agent 帮你找歌、播放、管理队列和歌单，在 设置 → MCP 中开启
- **系统集成**：支持 macOS 媒体键和控制中心
- **多语言**：支持简体中文、繁体中文、English、日本語、한국어、Deutsch、Français、Español、Русский

### 💡 从旧版升级

- 3.0 是一个全新的应用，官方不再提供网易云音乐。想听在线的歌，可以装插件：去 [yesplaymusic-plugin](https://github.com/topics/yesplaymusic-plugin) 找找别人做好的，或者照着 [插件开发指南](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/blob/main/docs/plugins.md) 自己写一个
- 旧版的代码保留在 [`1.x`](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/tree/1.x) 分支，之后不再更新

### 📦 下载

- **macOS**：下载 `.dmg`，只支持 M 系列芯片的 Mac
- **Windows**：下载 `-setup.exe` 安装，或者下载 `-portable.zip` 解压直接用；如果 Windows 提示「已保护你的电脑」，点「更多信息」再点「仍要运行」
- **Linux**：下载 `.tar.gz`，需要先装 libmpv

感谢这些年一直在用 YesPlayMusic 的每一位！希望新版本能继续陪你听歌。

---

Long time no see! YesPlayMusic is finally back (and no, it's not dead).

3.0 is a ground-up rewrite in Flutter with an all-new design. It's a proper native app now, not a web page in a wrapper, and it's a lot lighter too. Here's what's new 👇

### ✨ What's New

- **Album shelf**: Your albums line up on a shelf like a real record collection, with a timeline along the bottom to get around fast
- **Coverflow**: The classic Cover Flow from the iPod and iTunes is back. Flip through your albums, artists and songs
- **Local music**: Point it at your music folders and you're good to go. Artwork and lyrics are picked up automatically
- **Plugins**: Stream from Jellyfin, Emby, Plex and more through plugins, or build your own with the [plugin guide](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/blob/main/docs/plugins.md)
- **AI assistant**: Let your AI agent find songs, control playback and manage your queue and playlists over MCP. Turn it on in Settings → MCP
- **Plays nice with macOS**: Media keys and Control Center just work
- **Languages**: Available in English, 简体中文, 繁體中文, 日本語, 한국어, Deutsch, Français, Español and Русский

### 💡 Coming from 0.4.x?

- 3.0 is a whole new app, and NetEase Cloud Music is no longer built in. Want to stream? Grab a plugin from [yesplaymusic-plugin](https://github.com/topics/yesplaymusic-plugin), or roll your own with the [plugin guide](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/blob/main/docs/plugins.md)
- The old version still lives in the [`1.x`](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/tree/1.x) branch, but it won't get any more updates

### 📦 Download

- **macOS**: Grab the `.dmg` (Apple Silicon only)
- **Windows**: Grab `-setup.exe` to install, or `-portable.zip` if you'd rather not install anything. If you see "Windows protected your PC", click **More info** → **Run anyway**
- **Linux**: Grab the `.tar.gz`. You'll need libmpv installed

Thanks to everyone who's stuck with YesPlayMusic all these years. Here's to many more songs together.

detail.readme:
# YesPlayMusic **A good-looking desktop music player, with music sources provided by plugins** macOS · Windows · Linux [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/qier222/YesPlayMusic?style=flat-square&color=D6B0FA)](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/releases/latest) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/qier222/YesPlayMusic/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square&label=CI)](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3.0-8FE3C0?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md) [Download](#download) · [Features](#features) · [Screenshots](#screenshots) · [Installing plugins](#installing-plugins) · [Writing plugins](#writing-plugins) · [AI assistants (MCP)](#ai-assistants-mcp) · [Building from source](#building-from-source)
## What is this YesPlayMusic 3.0 is a desktop music player rewritten from scratch in Flutter. The old Electron version is on the [`1.x` branch](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/tree/1.x). It **ships with no online music service**: it plays local music out of the box, and online catalogs, playlists, lyrics, comments and so on all come from plugins. Plugins run in a sandbox built into the app; their manifests declare which websites, local app channels and programs they can access. ## Download Download the package for your system from [Releases](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/releases/latest): | System | File | Notes | | ----------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | | macOS 12+ (Apple Silicon) | `YesPlayMusic--macos.dmg` | M-series chips | | macOS 12+ (Intel) | `YesPlayMusic--macos-x64.dmg` | Not available in 3.0.0 | | Windows 10/11 x64 | `-windows-x64-setup.exe` or `-portable.zip` | The installer is not code-signed; if SmartScreen warns, click "More info → Run anyway" | | Linux x64 / arm64 | `-linux-x64.tar.gz` or `-linux-arm64.tar.gz` | Requires libmpv: `sudo apt install libmpv2` (`libmpv1` on older distributions) | The 3.0.0 release does not include Intel Mac or Linux arm64 packages. The release workflow on `main` now supports both. The official macOS and Windows builds use Sparkle and WinSparkle for updates. On Linux and in source builds without these updaters, new versions are shown in Settings → About. ## Features - **A record-shelf library**: albums stand on a shelf like book spines, sorted by title or release date; songs are grouped by the month they were added, and artists are shown as bubbles. - **3D Coverflow**: flip through albums, playlists, songs and artists by dragging, scrolling or using the arrow keys, and click to play. - **Colors from cover art**: the album and Now Playing pages take their background from the cover's dominant color; choose from 6 accent colors (Lilac, Sky, Mint, Sun, Rose, Flame). - **Now Playing**: lyrics with translations, the play queue, similar songs and song comments, all on one page. - **Local music**: scans your music folders and reads tags, embedded cover art and `.lrc` lyrics; supports FLAC, MP3, M4A, WAV, AIFF, OGG, OPUS, APE and more. - **Multiple music sources**: local music and plugins that provide search or a library are separate music sources; click or right-click the avatar in the bottom-left corner to switch. Home, Explore, Search, albums, artists and playlists all come from the current source. - **System integration**: Now Playing in the macOS Control Center and lock screen, media keys and headphone buttons; follows the system proxy. - **Keyboard control**: common actions have shortcuts, which won't fire while you're typing. On `main` (not yet released): gapless playback, ReplayGain volume normalization, a 10-band equalizer, a sleep timer and a macOS Dynamic Island mini player. Coverflow is at the right end of the Library tab row, and local folder scans show progress and can be canceled. ### Screenshots

Library: albums on a record shelf, with a release-date timeline below

3D Coverflow
Album: background follows the cover's dominant color

Now Playing: lyrics and translations
Now Playing: song comments

Home: provided by the current music source
Search

Playlist
Artist

Settings: 6 accent colors
Settings: plugins
## Installing plugins **Official plugins** | Plugin | For | | -------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------- | | Emby | Emby servers | | Jellyfin | Jellyfin servers | | Plex | Plex servers | | Subsonic | Navidrome, Gonic, Airsonic, Ampache and other Subsonic-compatible servers | | WebDAV | WebDAV servers: a NAS, Nextcloud, OpenList / AList and more (unreleased) | | Last.fm | Scrobbling to Last.fm with your own API key (unreleased) | | ListenBrainz | Scrobbling to ListenBrainz and compatible servers (unreleased) | | Discord | Show what you're listening to on your Discord profile (unreleased) | **Third-party plugins**: search GitHub for the [`yesplaymusic-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/yesplaymusic-plugin) topic. Please add this topic to your repository when you publish a plugin. **How to install**: Settings → Plugins → Install Plugin. Official plugins install with one click; for third-party plugins, paste a GitHub repository, Release or .zip link, or install from a local folder. If the plugin provides a music source, click or right-click the avatar in the bottom-left corner to switch to it. **Security**: installing a plugin means running someone else's code on your computer, so only install plugins you trust. The restrictions the app places on plugins are described in [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md); the main ones are: - each plugin runs in its own QuickJS sandbox, cannot read or write files or start processes directly, and has memory and time limits; - it can only access the websites declared in `permissions.network`; - it can only connect to local app channels declared in `permissions.ipc`; - launching a program on your computer (such as `yt-dlp`) must be declared in the manifest and separately allowed by you in Settings. ## Writing plugins A plugin is a `plugin.json` plus a JavaScript module; the app shows whatever features the exported functions provide. Plugins lay out their own Home and Explore pages: the app has several built-in components (special-mode cards, horizontal card shelves, paged song grids, charts, card grids) that plugins can combine freely. If you need a different kind of component, please [open an issue](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/issues/new/choose). See the [plugin development guide](docs/plugins.md) for the full API. ## AI assistants (MCP) The app has a built-in MCP server that lets AI agents such as Claude and Cursor search for songs, play music, and manage the queue and playlists for you. Turn it on in Settings → MCP. By default it only listens on `127.0.0.1:18888`, and you can enable token authentication and read-only mode. ```json { "mcpServers": { "yesplaymusic": { "url": "http://127.0.0.1:18888/mcp" } } } ``` Clients that only support stdio can use the `bin/ypm_mcp_bridge.dart` bridge in this repository; the settings page can copy the configuration for you. ## Building from source Requires Flutter 3.50 or later (Dart 3.14, which uses Build Hooks to compile the bundled QuickJS). ```sh git clone https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic.git cd YesPlayMusic flutter pub get flutter run -d macos # or windows / linux flutter test ``` Additional requirements per platform: - **macOS**: Xcode and CocoaPods. See [Releasing](docs/releasing.md#build-packages-locally) to build a package for a specific architecture. - **Windows**: Visual Studio 2022 with the "Desktop development with C++" workload - **Linux**: `sudo apt install clang cmake ninja-build pkg-config libgtk-3-dev liblzma-dev libmpv-dev` On Linux arm64, install Flutter from its Git tag as [CI does](.github/workflows/ci.yml). ## Feedback - Report problems and suggestions in [Issues](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/issues/new/choose). - Report security issues privately; see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md). ## License [GPL-3.0](LICENSE). Third-party components and their licenses are listed in [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md); see [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) for version history (in Chinese).

# YesPlayMusic **高颜值的桌面音乐播放器，音乐源由插件提供** macOS · Windows · Linux [![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/qier222/YesPlayMusic?style=flat-square&color=D6B0FA)](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/releases/latest) [![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/qier222/YesPlayMusic/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square&label=CI)](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-GPL--3.0-8FE3C0?style=flat-square)](./LICENSE) [English](README.md) | 简体中文 [下载](#下载) · [功能](#功能) · [截图](#截图) · [安装插件](#安装插件) · [开发插件](#开发插件) · [AI 助手（MCP）](#ai-助手mcp) · [从源码构建](#从源码构建)
## 这是什么 YesPlayMusic 3.0 是用 Flutter 从头重写的桌面音乐播放器。 旧版 Electron 的代码在 [`1.x` 分支](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/tree/1.x)。 它本身**不内置任何在线音乐服务**：开箱即可播放本地音乐，在线曲库、歌单、歌词、评论等都由插件提供。插件跑在应用内置的沙箱里，能访问哪些网站、连接哪些本机应用通道、启动哪些程序，都要在插件清单里声明。 ## 下载 在 [Releases](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/releases/latest) 页面下载对应系统的安装包： | 系统 | 文件 | 说明 | | ----------------- | ------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------- | | macOS 12+（Apple Silicon） | `YesPlayMusic-<版本>-macos.dmg` | M 系列芯片 | | macOS 12+（Intel） | `YesPlayMusic-<版本>-macos-x64.dmg` | 3.0.0 未提供 | | Windows 10/11 x64 | `-windows-x64-setup.exe` 或 `-portable.zip` | 安装包没有代码签名，SmartScreen 提示时点「更多信息 → 仍要运行」 | | Linux x64 / arm64 | `-linux-x64.tar.gz` 或 `-linux-arm64.tar.gz` | 需要系统装有 libmpv：`sudo apt install libmpv2`（较旧的发行版是 `libmpv1`） | 3.0.0 没有 Intel Mac 或 Linux arm64 安装包；`main` 分支的发布工作流已支持这两种架构。 macOS 和 Windows 正式版分别用 Sparkle 和 WinSparkle 更新；Linux 和未启用这两种更新器的自行构建版本会在 设置 → 关于 里提示新版本。 ## 功能 - **唱片架式的音乐库**：专辑像书脊一样排在架上，按标题或发行时间排列；歌曲按加入时间分月显示，艺人以气泡呈现。 - **3D Coverflow**：拖拽、滚轮或方向键翻阅专辑、歌单、歌曲和艺人，点一下就播放。 - **封面取色**：专辑页、正在播放页的背景跟随封面主色；6 种主题色可选（丁香紫、天蓝、薄荷、日光、玫瑰、橙焰）。 - **正在播放**：歌词和翻译、播放队列、相似歌曲、歌曲评论，同一页里切换。 - **本地音乐**：扫描本地音乐文件夹，读取标签、内嵌封面和 `.lrc` 歌词，支持 FLAC、MP3、M4A、WAV、AIFF、OGG、OPUS、APE 等格式。 - **多个音乐源**：本地音乐和提供搜索或曲库的插件都是独立的音乐源，点击或右键左下角头像即可切换；首页、发现、搜索、专辑、歌手、歌单都由当前音乐源提供。 - **系统集成**：macOS 控制中心和锁屏的「正在播放」、媒体键和耳机按键；跟随系统代理。 - **键盘操作**：常用操作都有快捷键，打字时不会误触。 `main` 分支已有但尚未发布：无缝播放、ReplayGain 音量均衡、10 段均衡器、睡眠定时和 macOS 灵动岛迷你播放器。音乐库的 Coverflow 入口移到了标签栏最右侧，本地音乐扫描会显示进度，也可以取消。 ### 截图

音乐库：专辑排在唱片架上，下方按发行时间定位

3D Coverflow
专辑：背景跟随封面主色

正在播放：歌词和翻译
正在播放：歌曲评论

首页：由当前音乐源提供
搜索

歌单
歌手

设置：6 种主题色
设置：插件
## 安装插件 **官方插件** | 插件 | 适用于 | | -------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ | | Emby | Emby 服务器 | | Jellyfin | Jellyfin 服务器 | | Plex | Plex 服务器 | | Subsonic | Navidrome、Gonic、Airsonic、Ampache 等兼容 Subsonic 的服务器 | | WebDAV | NAS、Nextcloud、OpenList / AList 等 WebDAV 服务器（尚未发布） | | Last.fm | 用自己的 API key 把听歌记录上报到 Last.fm（尚未发布） | | ListenBrainz | 把听歌记录上报到 ListenBrainz 或兼容的自建服务（尚未发布） | | Discord | 在 Discord 个人资料上显示正在听的歌（尚未发布） | **第三方插件**：在 GitHub 上搜索 [`yesplaymusic-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/yesplaymusic-plugin) topic。发布插件时也请给仓库加上这个 topic。 **安装方法**：设置 → 插件 → 安装插件。官方插件点一下就能装；第三方插件粘贴 GitHub 仓库、Release 或 .zip 链接，也可以从本地文件夹安装。如果插件提供音乐源，装好后点击或右键左下角头像即可切换。 **安全**：安装插件等于在本机运行别人写的代码，请只安装信任的插件。应用对插件做的限制见 [SECURITY.zh-CN.md](SECURITY.zh-CN.md)，主要有： - 每个插件跑在独立的 QuickJS 沙箱里，不能直接读写文件或启动进程，有内存和超时限制； - 只能访问 `permissions.network` 里声明的网站； - 只能连接 `permissions.ipc` 里声明的本机应用通道； - 启动本机程序（比如 `yt-dlp`）要在清单里声明，并由你在设置里单独允许。 ## 开发插件 一个插件就是一份 `plugin.json` 加一个 JavaScript 模块，导出哪些函数，应用就显示哪些功能。 首页和发现页由插件自己组织：应用内置了多种组件（特殊模式卡片、横向卡片架、歌曲翻页网格、排行榜、卡片网格），插件可以自由组合。需要其他形态的组件，请[提 Issue](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/issues/new/choose)。 完整接口见 [插件开发指南](docs/plugins.zh-CN.md)。 ## AI 助手（MCP） 应用内置一个 MCP Server，可以让 Claude、Cursor 等 AI Agent 帮你搜歌、播放、管理队列和歌单。在 设置 → MCP 里开启，默认只监听 `127.0.0.1:18888`，可以开启 Token 鉴权和只读模式。 ```json { "mcpServers": { "yesplaymusic": { "url": "http://127.0.0.1:18888/mcp" } } } ``` 只支持 stdio 的客户端可以用仓库里的 `bin/ypm_mcp_bridge.dart` 桥接，设置页里能一键复制配置。 ## 从源码构建 需要 Flutter 3.50 或更新的版本（Dart 3.14，用 Build Hooks 编译内置的 QuickJS）。 ```sh git clone https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic.git cd YesPlayMusic flutter pub get flutter run -d macos # 或 windows / linux flutter test ``` 各平台额外需要： - **macOS**：Xcode 和 CocoaPods。按架构出包请参照[发布流程](docs/releasing.zh-CN.md#本地出包)。 - **Windows**：Visual Studio 2022，勾选「使用 C++ 的桌面开发」 - **Linux**：`sudo apt install clang cmake ninja-build pkg-config libgtk-3-dev liblzma-dev libmpv-dev` Linux arm64 上请参照 [CI](.github/workflows/ci.yml) 从 Git 标签安装 Flutter。 ## 反馈 - 问题和建议请提 [Issue](https://github.com/qier222/YesPlayMusic/issues/new/choose)。 - 安全问题请私下报告，见 [SECURITY.zh-CN.md](SECURITY.zh-CN.md)。 ## 协议 [GPL-3.0](LICENSE)。使用的第三方组件及其协议见 [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.zh-CN.md](THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.zh-CN.md)，版本变化见 [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)。
